skeleton.$description: Loading placeholders. The shimmer is continuous, so it is the clearest case for the reduced-motion collapse: under prefers-reduced-motion the sweep stops and the placeholder holds its base color. A skeleton must never be the only signal that content is loading — pair it with an aria-busy region or a status message.

highlight.$description: Shimmer sweep — deliberately low contrast against base, since it carries no information.

radius.$description: Placeholder radius for blocks and controls.

line-height.$description: Height of a single text-line placeholder.
